faqs.answer: No. It only decodes the header and payload. A decoded token is not proof that its signature or claims are valid.

faqs.question: Is the token uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Decoding happens locally in your browser.

faqs.question: Should I paste a production access token?
faqs.answer: Avoid sharing sensitive credentials. Treat tokens as secrets even when using a local decoder.

seo.tips: Never trust claims until the token's signature and relevant claims have been verified by the intended application.

title: XML Formatter
description: Validate and format XML into readable, indented markup in your browser.
tagline: Turn compact XML into readable markup

seo.description: Validate and format XML with readable indentation in your browser. Invalid XML is reported before a formatted result is produced.
steps: Paste XML into the input box.
Select Format XML to validate and indent the markup.
Copy or download the formatted result.
features: Checks XML syntax using the browser's XML parser.
Adds readable indentation to valid XML.
Processes input locally without an external API.

faqs.question: Does it repair invalid XML?
faqs.answer: No. It reports parsing errors; fix the XML source before formatting.

faqs.question: Is XML sent to a server?
faqs.answer: No. Validation and formatting happen in your browser.

faqs.question: Does formatting change the meaning of XML?
faqs.answer: The formatter parses valid XML and changes its indentation for readability. It does not intentionally change element names or values.

seo.tips: Keep a copy of the original XML before making structural edits.

title: PDF Images Extractor
description: Extract supported embedded raster images from PDF pages and download them individually or as a ZIP.
tagline: Save embedded images from PDF files

seo.description: Extract supported embedded raster images from PDF documents locally. Preview results and download images individually or as a ZIP archive.
steps: Choose a PDF file up to 25 MB and 200 pages.
Select Extract Images and wait while supported embedded images are decoded in your browser.
Preview results, download individual files or choose Download All as ZIP.
features: Finds supported embedded raster image objects in PDF pages.
Shows extracted image previews with page and image information.
Downloads individual images or bundles them into a ZIP archive.
Processes document bytes locally in your browser.

faqs.question: Are my PDF files uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. PDF parsing and image extraction run locally in your browser. PDF.js and ZIP support load from public CDNs when needed.

faqs.question: Will every image in every PDF be extracted?
faqs.answer: Common embedded raster objects are supported. Some unusual masks, inline encodings or unsupported formats may be skipped.

faqs.question: Does this extract images from scanned PDF pages?
faqs.answer: It extracts embedded raster objects when available. It does not perform OCR or recreate a full-page scan as an original image.

seo.tips: Keep the original PDF. Color spaces, masks and transparency can affect extracted image appearance.
